jobs.name: oriru-application-pulse
jobs.prompt: OpenRouter provider application status pulse (awai-network, submitted 2026-09-04). 捏造ゼロ — unknown は unknown と書く。 Compare against ~/.hermes/profiles/oriru/plans/oriru-status-latest.md FIRST; if all findings unchanged, output one line 差分なし + 3 statuses and stop. Else full run: (1) GET https://api.murakumo.cloud/v1/models (30s timeout) — report HTTP status and whether selector awai-network/basho is listed. (2) POST one chat completion to https://api.murakumo.cloud/v1/chat/completions model=awai-network/basho max_tokens=32 message 'Reply exactly: OK' WITHOUT credentials — 402 self_model_requires_identity is the correct fail-closed state, not an outage; if 200 report the exact .model. (3) GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/providers — report whether slug awai-network exists (go-live signal). Overwrite ~/.hermes/profiles/oriru/plans/oriru-status-latest.md with full findings.

jobs.name: oriru-weekly-review
jobs.prompt: Weekly provider-onboarding review (oriru). 捏造ゼロ。 Tasks: (1) Email check: look for any message from OpenRouter (Slack Connect invite, review status) to support@murakumo.cloud — report exact findings or 'no email observed'. Use available email tooling if configured; otherwise state plainly it was not checked and why. (2) Privacy DRAFT tracker: fetch https://murakumo.cloud/legal-privacy and count remaining [CONFIRM] markers; list the section titles still marked. (3) Uptime proposal: check if ~/.hermes/profiles/oriru/plans/uptime-cold-start-proposal.md exists; if not, create a 1-page draft comparing keep-warm vs early-429 for the basho Modal cold start (measured 60-105s of 503), with OpenRouter uptime thresholds (95%+ normal routing, 80-94% reduced, <80% fallback-only) and costs, for owner decision. (4) Append a dated one-paragraph summary to ~/.hermes/profiles/oriru/plans/oriru-weekly-log.md.
